responsibility: This file implements a lightweight context-aware pointer equivalence analyzer for SSA GIMPLE, intended to be used during dominator walks. It tracks global and conditional equivalences from assignments, constant-folded expressions, PHIs with invariant pointees, and branch conditions such as p == &obj, maintaining a scoped stack of edge-sensitive replacements. Its main product is get_equiv, which answers what invariant address or equivalent pointer SSA a pointer name denotes at the current program point, helping value and range reasoning use pointer equalities discovered from control flow.
same_name_distinction: Implements the analyzer declared in value-pointer-equiv.h: it contains the dominator-walk state and algorithms that discover and maintain global and edge-conditional pointer equivalences from PHIs, assignments, folds, and branch conditions.
